const PARAM_HANDLERS: Readonly<Record<string, (_bg, v) => void>>;

Defined in: experiments/earth-playground/space/controls.ts:345

Param → EarthBackground setter dispatch. Each entry adapts a raw UI value (slider units / checkbox boolean) into the matching engine update call — the UI never touches engine internals directly. EARTH_SPEED divides by 10000 because the slider range 0–50 is human-friendly while the engine expects radians-per-frame (1 ⇒ 0.0001 rad/frame ≈ slow cinematic spin).
